hero.headlineHtml:
Some decisions
span generations.
Let's get this one right.
hero.sub: Multifamily advisory and brokerage for apartment owners throughout Portland, the Willamette Valley, and beyond. Whether you're considering a sale or planning for the future, the conversation starts here.

philosophy.headline: The goal isn't to close a deal. It's to help you make the right decision, even if that means waiting.
philosophy.body: With more than fifteen years of multifamily brokerage experience and firsthand apartment ownership, Gerding Commercial Real Estate brings both market knowledge and an owner's perspective to every conversation.

owner.headline: An owner's perspective. Long before becoming a broker.
owner.intro: Real estate has been part of my life for as long as I can remember. My parents owned a fourplex and a fiveplex, and I saw firsthand the work, decisions, and commitment that went into making those investments successful. Years later, I helped sell those properties and grow our family's portfolio. Today, as both an apartment owner and a broker, I bring that same ownership perspective to the advice I give clients.
owner.quote: There's a difference between understanding what a property is worth and understanding what it means to own it.

howIWork.headline:
Thoughtful process.
Decisive execution.
howIWork.sub: Every property and every owner presents a different set of circumstances. The approach is straightforward: understand the investment, evaluate the options, and execute with purpose when the time is right.

steps.title: Listen
steps.body: Every property serves a purpose. Understanding its role in your investment strategy, your financial goals, and your plans for the future is where the conversation begins.

steps.title: Advise
steps.body: Selling isn't always the right answer. Understanding the market, evaluating the available options, and weighing the potential outcomes helps determine the best path forward.

steps.title: Negotiate
steps.body: Listing a property is the easy part. A successful sale depends on choosing the right buyer, defending your price, and knowing when to stand firm and when to bend.

steps.title: Beyond Closing
steps.body: The relationship doesn't end at closing. From rental rates and refinancing to future acquisitions and sales, Gerding CRE remains a resource for the decisions that come next.

howIWork.quote: The value of good advice is measured in the decisions you make. The value of good execution is measured in the results.
